printer_addon.config.addonEnabled.name: Add-on on (off: plain Litematica Printer)
printer_addon.config.addonEnabled.commen:
Turns the whole add-on on or off. Off: Litematica Printer works exactly as without the add-on
(no view turning, no build order, no breaking). Hotkey J+A, or the button at the top of the J+B menu.
printer_addon.config.autoBuild.name: Auto build
printer_addon.config.autoBuild.comment: Main switch. Turns on the printer and lets the add-on break wrong blocks and step through layers.
printer_addon.config.stopAt.name: Stop at (time of day)
printer_addon.config.stopAt.comment:
Stop the build (and Auto break) at this time of day, like 07:00 (your computer's clock). Once, then it's
cleared. Empty: no stop time. Can be set from Discord too (/schedule).
printer_addon.config.showHud.name: Build status on screen
printer_addon.config.showHud.comment: During auto build, show a small box at the top left: layer, blocks left, time to go, speed, what's missing.
printer_addon.config.resumeAfterRejoin.n: Go on after a restart or disconnect
printer_addon.config.resumeAfterRejoin.c:
If auto build was running when you logged out or lost the connection, start it again 10 seconds after
rejoining the same server with the same schematic. It goes on from the first unfinished layer.
printer_addon.config.reconnect.name: Join again after a kick or restart
printer_addon.config.reconnect.comment:
If the server kicks you or restarts while auto build runs, join it again by itself: 10 s after the
'Disconnected' screen, then 20 s, 30 s and every minute, for half an hour. Click 'Back to server list'
to cancel. Never after a ban, nor when you leave yourself; it stops after 3 kicks in 10 minutes.
Once back at the build, it goes on (see 'Go on after a restart or disconnect').
printer_addon.config.backToBuildCommands:
Commands that take you back to the build after joining again, or when the server moved you away (to a
hub): run one by one, 8 seconds apart, then again every minute until you're back at the build (for
half an hour). Comma between them, no /. Empty: none. On mythian, /server Skyblock puts you back
exactly where you logged out. Stop auto build first (J+Q) when you leave on purpose, or it brings you back.
printer_addon.config.buildRenderDistance:
Render distance (chunks) while auto build runs, for less lag on a slow computer. Your own setting comes
back when it stops. 0 = don't change it.
printer_addon.config.speedPreset.name: Speed preset
printer_addon.config.speedPreset.comment: How fast everything runs. Safe / Normal / Fast, or Custom to use the values in the Speed tab.
printer_addon.config.applySpeedToPrinter:
During auto build, set Litematica Printer's own settings: the interval (starting at yours, then the automatic
speed), rotate and interact blocks on. The range stays yours. Your own values come back when it stops.
Give the server the printer's direction when it clicks, so observers, pistons, hoppers, stairs etc. face
the right way (in 26.2 the server takes the direction you look in). Mythian build: the camera only faces
that way during the click itself. Official build: the camera really turns to each block clicked.
printer_addon.config.openInventoryForIte:
Open the inventory to move items in it (hotbar refills, tools, stacks), and stand still meanwhile, as a
player has to. It closes again by itself. Off: items are moved without it (faster, less like a player).
printer_addon.config.showAdvancedTabs.co:
Show every tab of settings (Advanced) instead of only Controls, Build, Auto break, Basic settings and
Commands. The 'Advanced' button at the end of the tabs switches it too.
printer_addon.config.chatMessages.name: Chat messages
printer_addon.config.chatMessages.commen: Show status messages in chat (layer done, stuck, scan results...).
printer_addon.config.detailedChat.name: Detailed chat
printer_addon.config.detailedChat.commen: Say in chat every step auto build takes: walking, flying, breaking, air placing...
printer_addon.config.statusFile.name: Write status file
printer_addon.config.statusFile.comment:
Write what auto build is doing to config/printer_addon/status.json every 2 seconds
(next block, blocks left, what is missing), for a live view outside the game.
printer_addon.config.debugLog.name: Debug log
printer_addon.config.debugLog.comment:
Write every step (which block is broken, why it stopped...) to the game log (logs/latest.log).
Useful when something doesn't work.
printer_addon.config.textBuildLog.name: Text build log
printer_addon.config.textBuildLog.commen:
Also write each build log as plain text (the same name, .log) next to the .jsonl file.
The .jsonl has the same lines; send that one when something went wrong.
printer_addon.config.shareLogsAutomatica:
Off by default. On: every auto build and Auto break run's log goes to the add-on's developer (a Discord channel)
when the run ends, however it ended, to find bugs and make it faster. With it the debug: versions, mods,
settings, PC, the game log without chat. The log has the build's coordinates, your inventory and
balance, the server and your name; never chat, chest or vault spots. Off: you're asked after each run.
printer_addon.config.logChannel.name: Log channel (Discord webhook)
printer_addon.config.logChannel.comment: Where shared logs go: a Discord webhook URL. Empty: the add-on developer's channel.
printer_addon.config.discordSync.name: Discord sync
printer_addon.config.discordSync.comment:
Linked with Discord (J+L): send live status and alerts to your control room on the Printer Addon Discord,
and take Pause / Resume / Stop from there. Never sends chat, coordinates, chests or vaults.
printer_addon.config.discordApi.name: Discord bot address
printer_addon.config.discordApi.comment: The Printer Addon bot's address. Leave it as it is unless the developer says otherwise.
printer_addon.config.keepMoney.name: Keep at least this much money
printer_addon.config.keepMoney.comment:
Never spend below this much money (read from the sidebar's balance): what's left above it is what the
build may spend. 0: no limit. Can be set from Discord too (/schedule).
printer_addon.config.layerCostAlert.name: Warn when a layer costs more
printer_addon.config.layerCostAlert.comm:
Warn (in chat and Discord) when a layer cost much more than the layers before it: a shop price went up,
or something is bought that shouldn't be.
printer_addon.config.fetchFromChests.nam: Use linked chests and vaults first
printer_addon.config.fetchFromChests.com:
Before buying, take missing items from the chests, barrels and shulker boxes you linked (J+B, Build tab:
look at one and press 'Link chest'). No other chest is ever opened. They have to be loaded (in view distance).
Your player vaults to use as storage, like chests: items are taken from them before buying (pumpkins to
craft seeds from, for example) and leftovers are put in them. Numbers, e.g. 1-6 or 1,2,3. Empty = none.
printer_addon.config.putAwayOnStop.name: Put items away when stopping
printer_addon.config.putAwayOnStop.comme:
When auto build stops (you stop it, or the build is done): the building materials, what the add-on crafts
with and its hoes go into your vaults (and linked chests within reach). The next start takes what it needs
again (or buys it). Never buckets, food, armor, weapons, nor anything renamed or enchanted. If it doesn't
all fit, it says so: link a chest for the rest (J+B).
printer_addon.config.vaultCommand.name: Vault command
printer_addon.config.vaultCommand.commen: Command that opens a player vault, without the slash (the vault number is added).
printer_addon.config.autoBuy.name: Buy what's missing in the shop
printer_addon.config.autoBuy.comment:
During auto build, buy what the current layer is missing from the shop (as much as fits in the inventory).
Needs a shop scan of the server first (J+S). When auto build starts it asks how much it may spend.
printer_addon.config.stockUpVaults.name: Buy in bulk into vaults
printer_addon.config.stockUpVaults.comme:
Buy in bulk into your vaults (and linked chests): when the shop has to be used, a whole inventory of one
item is bought at a time and put away, up to what the build still needs and the vaults have room for;
the inventory is then filled from the vaults. The next trips only open a vault (2 s instead of 14 s in
the shop). The more vaults and chests it may use, the more it buys ahead.
printer_addon.config.sellLeftovers.name: Sell leftovers when storage is full
printer_addon.config.sellLeftovers.comme:
When storage is full (or there is none) and the inventory needs room: sell in the shop what the build
doesn't need any more and the shop buys back (shift + right click, 'sell all'). Only the schematic's
own materials, never tools, renamed or enchanted items. What the shop doesn't buy stays in your
inventory (dropped only when the build is stuck for room).
printer_addon.config.buyWhenLeft.name: Buy when this many are left
printer_addon.config.buyWhenLeft.comment:
Only get more of an item (from linked chests or the shop) once this many or fewer are left in the inventory.
How much is bought is shared between the items the layer needs, and a few slots always stay free.
printer_addon.config.buyStacksBelow.name: Whole stacks below (price per stack)
printer_addon.config.buyStacksBelow.comm:
Items whose stack costs less than this are only bought by the whole stack (the shop's stacks screen), the
amount rounded up: what's left over goes into storage for later. Setting an exact amount takes many
clicks (102 mud). Pricier ones (blocks of diamond or iron) are bought exactly. 0 = always exactly.
printer_addon.config.craftFromBlocks.nam: Buy blocks and craft them back
printer_addon.config.craftFromBlocks.com:
The add-on always buys the cheapest way by the shop scan (seeds or pumpkins, ingots or blocks, dust or
blocks). On: when the prices aren't known, or cost the same, blocks are bought and crafted back (fewer
purchases). The blocks are always bought when the item itself can't be (not sold, or not delivered).
printer_addon.config.useCraftCommand.com:
Open a crafting table with the server's craft command when a recipe needs one (rails, hoes), instead of
placing one. If the command does nothing (no permission), a crafting table is used as before.
printer_addon.config.craftCommand.name: Craft command
printer_addon.config.craftCommand.commen: The command that opens a crafting table, without the slash.
printer_addon.config.shopCommand.name: Shop command
printer_addon.config.shopCommand.comment: Command that opens the shop, without the slash.
printer_addon.config.shopSection.name: Money shop button
printer_addon.config.shopSection.comment:
Which button in the /shop main menu leads to the money shop. Only that one is opened.
An item id (minecraft:paper) or part of the button's name. Empty = open every button.
printer_addon.config.probeBuyScreen.name: Read the buy screen during scan
printer_addon.config.probeBuyScreen.comm:
During a scan, left-click the cheapest item once to read the buy screen (amount buttons, confirm button),
then close it without confirming. If the shop buys instantly on click, this buys 1 of that item.
printer_addon.config.maxPagesPerCategory: Stop scanning a category after this many pages.
printer_addon.config.shopWaitTimeoutTick: How long to wait for the server to open or change a shop menu before giving up (20 ticks = 1 second).
printer_addon.config.movementMode.name: Movement (fly is fastest)
printer_addon.config.movementMode.commen:
How auto build gets you to the next unfinished blocks: fly (fastest: always above the blocks being built),
walk, walk and fly when needed, or not at all.
printer_addon.config.flyCommand.name: Fly command
printer_addon.config.flyCommand.comment: Command (without the slash) sent once if flying is needed but not allowed yet. Empty: never send one.
printer_addon.config.keepMoving.name: Keep moving
printer_addon.config.keepMoving.comment:
Flying: when only a few blocks are left to place where you are, already fly on to the next spot (the printer
places the last ones on the way) instead of stopping until everything around is done.
printer_addon.config.flyInLanes.name: Fly in lanes
printer_addon.config.flyInLanes.comment:
Full layers (a farm's dirt, mud, stems, observers, redstone...) are flown over in straight lanes, the printer
placing all the way: as fast as the printer keeps up, slowing down only so nothing is left behind.
Layers of chains (hoppers into hoppers) and what's left at the end go spot by spot as before.
printer_addon.config.hoverHeightAbove.co: When flying, hover this many blocks above the layer being built (1 = right above it, the most reach).
printer_addon.config.workWaitSeconds.com:
If nothing within reach gets done for this long (missing item, printer can't place it...),
move on and come back to those blocks later.
printer_addon.config.maxWalkDistance.com: Farthest the pathfinder looks for a walking route. Farther away: fly (if allowed).
printer_addon.config.stopOnDamage.name: Stop when you take damage
printer_addon.config.stopOnDamage.commen: Stop auto build when you take damage.
printer_addon.config.stopNearPlayers.nam: Stop when a player comes close
printer_addon.config.stopNearPlayers.com: Stop auto build when another player comes close.
Distance in blocks for 'Stop near other players'.
printer_addon.config.trustedPlayers.name: Players who don't stop it
printer_addon.config.trustedPlayers.comm: Players who don't stop the build when they come close (friends, island members), comma separated: Pouched, Vanzu_
printer_addon.config.autoEat.name: Eat when hungry
printer_addon.config.autoEat.comment:
During auto build, eat when the food bar gets low (starving hurts, and damage stops auto build).
Never eats rotten flesh, spider eyes, poisonous potatoes, pufferfish, chorus fruit, raw chicken or golden apples.
printer_addon.config.eatBelow.name: Eat at food level
printer_addon.config.eatBelow.comment: Eat when the food bar is at this or lower (20 is full, every drumstick is 2).
printer_addon.config.useFeedCommand.name: Eat with /feed
printer_addon.config.useFeedCommand.comm:
Fill the food bar with the server's feed command instead of eating (if you're allowed to use it).
If the command does nothing (no permission), food from the inventory is eaten instead.
printer_addon.config.feedCommand.name: Feed command
printer_addon.config.feedCommand.comment: The feed command, without the slash.
printer_addon.config.autoLayer.name: Auto layer
printer_addon.config.autoLayer.comment: While auto build is on, build one Y layer at a time from the bottom and go to the next layer when it's done.
printer_addon.config.buildLayersTogether:
Build the layer above together with the one below when what goes there stands on the blocks below (seeds and
stems on farmland, redstone dust on observers and pistons): placed right behind the block under them, in the
same lanes, instead of flying over the whole build again for them. Off: always one layer at a time.
printer_addon.config.capBeforeStop.name: Cover cactus before stopping
printer_addon.config.capBeforeStop.comme:
When you stop the build, the sand beside cactus left open on top goes in first (a few seconds; at most
90): open cactus grow while it's stopped and have to be broken one by one after. Stop again to stop at once.
printer_addon.config.addonPlacesBlocks.c:
Let the add-on place what Litematica Printer can't: rails (with temporary rails for the right shape) and
minecarts. Off: the printer places every block and the add-on only moves, breaks wrong blocks, gets the
items and sets the printer's settings. Water (waterlogged blocks) is always put in with a bucket.
printer_addon.config.layerCheckIntervalT: How often (in ticks) to check if the current layer is finished (at least 40: a check reads the whole layer).
If the layer hasn't changed for this long, list in chat what is left and why.
printer_addon.config.skipStuckSeconds.co:
If blocks you have the items for still can't be placed after this long (e.g. two rails side by side
that the game always connects), go on to the next layer and list them at the end to do by hand.
Blocks you don't have the items for are waited for.
printer_addon.config.extraBlocksBlockLay:
Count blocks where the schematic has air (terrain, stray blocks) as unfinished.
Off: only blocks the schematic needs count. Use the 'Clear extra blocks' key to remove them.
printer_addon.config.useAirPlaceForFloat:
Blocks with nothing beside or under them to place them against (the string at the bottom of a cactus farm)
are placed in the air with the printer's 'printInAir': for the whole layer when all its blocks come out
right that way (string, sand, cactus, plain blocks), else one block at a time. Only while such blocks are
left. If the server doesn't keep blocks placed in the air, it stops by itself and says so.
printer_addon.config.breakWrongBlocks.co: While auto build is on, break blocks that don't match the schematic so the printer can place the right one.
printer_addon.config.breakBlocksNotInSch: Break blocks not in the schematic

Also break blocks that aren't part of the schematic, inside its area and the layers being built: blocks where
the schematic has air (terrain, leftovers, a stray block), and blocks of yours where the schematic wants
something else (dirt or farmland where the floor goes): broken, and the right block goes in.
Containers and unbreakable blocks are never broken. Off: those are left alone (and listed as conflicts).
printer_addon.config.breakWrongState.com:
Also break the right block when it faces the wrong way or has the wrong half/type (stairs, observers, logs, slabs).
Things the printer can fix by clicking (repeater delay, comparator mode, doors, levers) are left to the printer.
printer_addon.config.breakRange.name: Break range
printer_addon.config.breakRange.comment: How far away blocks can be broken. Also limited by the server's reach.
printer_addon.config.minToolDurability.c: Never use a tool that has this much durability left or less, so tools never break.
printer_addon.config.breakTimeoutSeconds: Give up on a block if it isn't broken after this many seconds (e.g. the server cancels it).
printer_addon.config.wrongForTicks.name: Wait before breaking (ticks)
printer_addon.config.maxBreaksPerBlock.c: Stop breaking a spot after this many tries if it keeps coming back wrong, and say so in chat.
printer_addon.config.lookAtBlocks.name: Look at blocks when breaking
printer_addon.config.lookAtBlocks.commen: Tell the server you look at the block being broken (your camera stays free). For servers with strict anticheat.
printer_addon.config.alwaysBreakBlocks.c:
Blocks broken wherever they are in the schematic's area while auto build is on, also where the schematic
has air and in layers already built (when the player comes by). Block ids, comma separated, e.g.
cactus_flower, or minecraft:cobweb. Empty: none.
printer_addon.config.skipContainers.name: Never break containers
printer_addon.config.skipContainers.comm: Never break chests, barrels, hoppers, shulker boxes, furnaces etc., even if they are wrong.
printer_addon.config.standToBreak.name: Stand while breaking
printer_addon.config.standToBreak.commen:
While breaking a block, stop flying for a moment and stand on the block under your feet when there is
one (the game breaks blocks 5 times slower in the air: a cactus takes 3 s flying, 0.6 s standing).
Never next to a cactus, never on the block being broken; it flies on right after.
printer_addon.config.autoBreakPickUp.com:
Auto break: what it breaks drops, and is picked up when it flies by. On: when the inventory is full,
the drops go into your vaults (/pv) or linked chests. Off: drops are ignored (breaking goes on
with a full inventory, the rest stays on the ground).
printer_addon.config.autoBreakSkip.name: Auto break: skip these blocks
printer_addon.config.autoBreakSkip.comme:
Auto break: block types it never breaks, by id (oak_log, chest...). Easiest set in the Auto break tab
(J+B): click a block of the selected area to skip it, again to break it.
printer_addon.config.autoSpeed.name: Automatic speed
printer_addon.config.autoSpeed.comment:
Find the fastest printer interval that still places right, per kind of block: start at the preset's interval,
go faster after a run of correct blocks, one tick slower as soon as a block comes out wrong.
printer_addon.config.autoSpeedMinInterva:
Automatic speed never goes below this printer interval. It only gets there while every block comes out
right, and slows down again at the first wrong one. Never below 2 (at 1 the server kicked the player).
The speed guard slows down by itself when the server is slow to answer.
printer_addon.config.speedGuard.name: Speed guard
printer_addon.config.speedGuard.comment:
Watches how fast the server answers the clicks. A click without an answer for 2 seconds: placing waits
for it, then goes on at at most 8 blocks a second, more again step by step after 30 s each. Answers
slow on average set a limit too. Every 10 s the build log gets a SERVER line with what it saw.
printer_addon.config.autoSpeedStepBlocks: Automatic speed goes one tick faster after this many correct blocks in a row.
printer_addon.config.minTicksBetweenPlac:
Ticks between two blocks placed (0: no wait, the printer's interval decides). 4 is as fast as holding
right-click in vanilla (5 blocks a second). Below 4 is faster than a player: many servers' anticheats
notice it and their rules may forbid it. Your choice, at your own risk.
printer_addon.config.maxPlacementsPerSec:
For servers with a strict anticheat: the printer places at most this many blocks per second. 0 = no limit
(the printer's interval decides). More than 5 is faster than a player holding right-click.
printer_addon.config.waitAfterSwitch.nam: Wait a tick after switching items
printer_addon.config.waitAfterSwitch.com:
A click never in the same tick as the switch to its item: it goes a tick later. Some servers refuse such
clicks (on play.mythian.net 7 % of the clicks right after a switch, against 0.5 % of the others).
Off: a little faster on servers that don't.
printer_addon.config.clickSeenFace.name: Click a side you can see
printer_addon.config.clickSeenFace.comme:
Clicks go on a side of a block the player can see, on the block's real shape (a cactus is thinner than
its block). Blocks that go in the same way from any side (string, sand) are clicked against another
block beside them when the printer's choice faces away: servers refuse those clicks.
printer_addon.config.lagPauseTps.name: Wait when server TPS below
printer_addon.config.lagPauseTps.comment:
On a server: stop placing while the server runs below this many ticks per second (20 is normal),
because clicks then get answered late and blocks come out wrong. 0 = never wait.
printer_addon.config.customPrinterInterv: Custom preset: the printer's printing interval (lower is faster). Below 12 the printer often places blocks wrong.
printer_addon.config.customBreakCooldown:
Custom preset: ticks to wait after breaking a block before the next one. 5 is vanilla's own wait;
below 5 is faster than a player (anticheats may notice it).
printer_addon.config.customShopClickDela: Custom preset: ticks to wait between clicks in the shop menu.
printer_addon.config.customWalkSpeed.com:
Custom preset: walking speed in blocks per tick (vanilla walking is about 0.21). Official build: above
vanilla only in singleplayer or where the server allows it (MOTD tag [printer_addon:allow-fast-movement]).
printer_addon.config.customFlySpeed.name: Custom: fly speed
printer_addon.config.customFlySpeed.comm:
Custom preset: flying speed in blocks per tick (vanilla flying is about 0.55). Official build: above
vanilla only in singleplayer or where the server allows it (MOTD tag [printer_addon:allow-fast-movement]).
printer_addon.config.openSettings.name: Open settings
printer_addon.config.linkDiscord.name: Link with Discord
printer_addon.config.linkDiscord.comment: Link the game with the Printer Addon Discord: type /link on Discord, then enter the code here.
printer_addon.config.buildMenu.name: Build menu
printer_addon.config.buildMenu.comment: Open the build menu: start / stop auto build, link the chest you look at, build report, cost, shop scan.
printer_addon.config.toggleAddon.name: Add-on on / off
printer_addon.config.toggleAddon.comment: Turn the whole add-on on or off (off: the printer works as without the add-on).
Start / stop auto build right away, without the menu.
printer_addon.config.startAutoBuild.name: Start auto build
printer_addon.config.startAutoBuild.comm:
Start auto build (or go on with a paused one). Does nothing while it's running.
No key by default: set one here.
printer_addon.config.stopAutoBuild.name: Stop auto build
printer_addon.config.stopAutoBuild.comme:
Stop auto build. Does nothing when it isn't running.
No key by default: set one here.
printer_addon.config.pauseAutoBuild.name: Pause / go on
printer_addon.config.pauseAutoBuild.comm: Pause auto build (it keeps its place and spending limit), and go on with it when pressed again.
printer_addon.config.stopAfterLayer.name: Stop after this layer
printer_addon.config.stopAfterLayer.comm: Stop auto build when the layer it's building now is done (press again to keep going).
printer_addon.config.fixWrongNow.name: Fix wrong blocks around me
printer_addon.config.fixWrongNow.comment: Break all wrong blocks within reach now (in the current layer range), even when auto build is off.
printer_addon.config.clearExtraBlocks.co: Break blocks within reach where the schematic has air (terrain, stray blocks), in the current layer range.
printer_addon.config.nextLayer.name: Next layer
printer_addon.config.previousLayer.name: Previous layer
printer_addon.config.showCost.name: Show cost of the build
printer_addon.config.showCost.comment: Show what the loaded schematic still needs and what it costs in the shop (also shown when a schematic is loaded).
printer_addon.config.buildReport.name: Build report
printer_addon.config.buildReport.comment:
Check the whole schematic: how much is done, missing or wrong, the nearest of each in chat,
and every spot with the reason in config/printer_addon/report.txt.
printer_addon.config.scanShop.name: Scan shop
printer_addon.config.scanShop.comment: Scan /shop: reads every category and page and saves where each item is and what it costs.
printer_addon.config.stopAll.name: Stop everything
printer_addon.config.stopAll.comment: Stop everything (auto build, breaking, shop scan). Also works while a menu is open.
